Field Descriptions

package_id_value

Package ID stored in fuse, divided into 8 words. The same value gets provisioned into SMCs in all chiplets of the same package. Words are defined as follows: [1:0]: Serial number of the package; [2]: Package Design Version, e.g. A1Q1/…​; [3]: Package Design ID, e.g. Grendel; [4]: Package User ID, e.g. if it’s TT who assembles the system, use TT’s GROUP_ID (32’b0); [5]: Package User Group ID; [7:6]: Reserved for extension
